title: subject:"仅读取IMG一次并锁定唯一MAIN. 从IMG提取FACE/HAIR/BODY/C0/ACC与整体设计语言…
content:
subject:"仅读取IMG一次并锁定唯一MAIN. 从IMG提取FACE/HAIR/BODY/C0/ACC与整体设计语言. 若IMG含多视图,仅作同一主体参考;若IMG为单图,禁止自行生成额外视图/额外人物/角色表式多面板. 全片只有一个MAIN. 白底/分栏/标注/角色表排版不属于MV世界."

vocal:"Original Japanese dance-music lead vocal; lyrics unspecified; freely improvised original Japanese phrases; clear Japanese pronunciation and lip sync; strong rhythmic hooks, short phrases, sustained notes; no existing-song quotation; no prompt reading; avoid ah/oh/woo-only loops."

music:"150 BPM maximal Japanese dance-pop/electro-house/hyper-club from frame one; huge four-on-floor kick,tight snare/clap,rolling sub,sidechained bass,bright supersaw,metallic percussion,vocal chops,rave stabs,arps,risers,impacts. Music foreground,loud,dense,no soft intro,no quiet breakdown. 0.5s style shift=accented hit;1s BG shift=kick+impact;3s camera/costume phase=fill+riser release."

PRIORITY:"1主体一致 2连续舞蹈 3MAIN本体描写变化 4camera 5服装vector 6BG/分屏 7typo. 若冲突,低优先级让步."

SUBJECT_SUPREMACY:"最高优先级: 全片始终只有同一个MAIN. 所有变化只能解释为同一MAIN被不同媒介/不同流行视觉语言重新描写,绝不能解释为换人/新角色/陌生角色/重新设计角色."

SUBJECT_CORE:"必须稳定: FACE骨相,脸型,眼型,眼距,眉鼻口比例,前发结构,发际线,HAIR主轮廓,HAIR关键连接点与发束拓扑,BODY头身比/肩宽/四肢比例,C0核心版型,ACC位置与配色关系. 禁止年龄感/性别感/体型/头身比/脸部比例/发型母体漂移."

IDENTITY_MODEL:"MAIN=IdentityCore+DepictionShell. IdentityCore绝对稳定;DepictionShell可激烈变化. 所有风格变化只作用于Shell,不得破坏Core."

IDENTITY_HARD_LOCK:"严格锁定FACE,HAIR,BODY,C0母体与ACC布局. 同一张脸,同一发型母体,同一身体比例,同一服装母体,同一饰品逻辑必须贯穿全片. 可以变描画方式,不能变主体."

IDENTITY_REPEAT:"再次强调: same MAIN,same face,same hair topology,same body proportion,same costume base,same accessories logic. 风格可变,人不能变. 描写可狂暴,身份不能漂."

RENDER_NOT_REDESIGN:"CHAR_FORM是高强度描写变化,不是弱滤镜,不是主体替换,不是换人,不是借题发挥生成风格代表角色. 模型必须改变MAIN的人体描画语言/线条/上色/材质/二维三维/印刷/工艺/抽象程度,但变化必须明确作用于MAIN这个人本身."

HUMAN_RENDER_RULE:"所有CHAR_FORM都必须直接作用于MAIN的人体本体. MAIN的人脸,头部,发型,颈部,肩膀,躯干,手臂,手,腰部,腿部,脚部,当前服装,饰品必须整体转换到目标描写体系. 必须same face in that style,same hairstyle in that style,same body proportions in that style,same costume in that style,same dance motion in that style."

NO_PROXY_SUBSTITUTION:"严禁代理替换. 禁止用陌生角色/独立玩偶/独立木偶/毛绒代角/无关黏土人/人物海报/陌生像素角色/风格典型人物来代替MAIN. 即使TOY/PLUSH/CLAY/POSTER/PIXEL/PUPPET_THEATER/WOODEN_STAGE_PUPPET等形式,也必须保持清楚的人形MAIN,不是替代物."

NO_OBJECT_ESCAPE:"禁止通过把MAIN变成一个物件来规避人体重绘要求. 即使是TOY,PLUSH,CLAY,POSTER,PIXEL,NEON,STAINED,PUPPET_THEATER,WOODEN_STAGE_PUPPET等,也必须保持清楚的人类头部/脸部/四肢/躯干/发型/服装结构. 禁止退化成摆件/道具/挂画/徽章/单独海报/非人主体."

FORM_METAMORPHOSIS_POLICY:"描写变化必须明显/大幅/可感知,目标不是轻微表面差异,而是让观众明确看到同一MAIN正在被不同视觉媒介连续改写. 若identity core已稳定,优先增强风格差异而不是弱化它. 目标是同一主体+千变万化描写."

CONSISTENCY_NOT_MONOTONY:"一致性只约束IdentityCore,不约束DepictionShell. 允许0.5s之间线条/笔触/材质/立体方式/印刷方式/抽象程度剧变,只要仍然一眼可判断是同一MAIN."

FORM_FAILURE:"若某段没有清楚表现为MAIN这个人的人体描写发生变化,而只是出现陌生角色/独立玩偶/独立木偶/背景人物/人物海报/无关像素角色/风格代表物,则该段失败."

DANCE_SUPREMACY:"除主体一致性外,连续舞蹈是第二最高优先级. MAIN从0.00s到15.00s始终处于明确舞蹈动作中. CHAR_FORM/COSTUME/BG/CAMERA/TYPO都必须附着在正在运动的MAIN上执行. 不得要求MAIN停下配合演出."

NO_STATIC:"禁止站立展示,禁止模特式静止pose,禁止等待camera,禁止为了identity anchor停止动作,禁止为了换装停止动作,禁止因为PLUSH/TOY/CLAY/POSTER/PUPPET_THEATER等媒介而变成静止展示物."

ACTIVE_ANCHOR:"identity reacquire不是静止pose. anchor发生时MAIN继续当前脚步/转身/arm movement,只短暂提升FACE/HAIR/COSTUME可读性. 身体运动绝不暂停."

goal:"15秒超高密度角色焦点MV. MAIN从0s持续日语唱跳. A=每0.5s切换CHAR_FORM;B=每1s切换BG世界;C=每3s切换camera grammar;D=每3s推进服装vector;E=少量单汉字/极短英字kinetic typography. 分屏只是背景演出,不是全片固定布局."

dance:"High-energy professional club choreography at 150 BPM: heel-toe,fast footwork,side travel,hip accents,shoulder hits,chest pops,arm waves,locking,body rolls,diagonal travel,half-turns,spins,rebounds,low-high changes,brief jumps,rhythmic head turns. 每1s至少一次动态全身dance read+一次清晰FACE/lip-sync read."

"0-.5 heel-toe forward + shoulder hit|
.5-1 lateral step + arm wave|
1-1.5 diagonal travel + chest pop|
1.5-2 half-turn rebound + hip accent|

en.content:
subject:"Read IMG only once and lock onto a single MAIN. Extract FACE/HAIR/BODY/C0/ACC and the overall design language from IMG. If IMG contains multiple views, treat them only as references for the same subject; if IMG is a single image, do not generate extra views/extra people/character-sheet-style multi-panels on your own. There is only one MAIN in the entire video. White backgrounds, split panels, labels, and character-sheet layouts do not belong to the MV world."

vocal:"Original Japanese dance-music lead vocal; lyrics unspecified; freely improvised original Japanese phrases; clear Japanese pronunciation and lip sync; strong rhythmic hooks, short phrases, sustained notes; no existing-song quotation; no prompt reading; avoid ah/oh/woo-only loops."

music:"150 BPM maximal Japanese dance-pop/electro-house/hyper-club from frame one; huge four-on-floor kick,tight snare/clap,rolling sub,sidechained bass,bright supersaw,metallic percussion,vocal chops,rave stabs,arps,risers,impacts. Music foreground,loud,dense,no soft intro,no quiet breakdown. 0.5s style shift=accented hit;1s BG shift=kick+impact;3s camera/costume phase=fill+riser release."

PRIORITY:"1 subject consistency 2 continuous dance 3 MAIN body depiction changes 4 camera 5 costume vector 6 BG/split-screen 7 typo. If there is a conflict, lower-priority items yield."

SUBJECT_SUPREMACY:"Highest priority: there is only the same MAIN throughout the entire video. All changes may only be interpreted as the same MAIN being redrawn through different media / different popular visual languages, and must never be interpreted as a different person / new character / unfamiliar character / redesigned character."

SUBJECT_CORE:"Must remain stable: FACE bone structure, face shape, eye shape, eye spacing, eyebrow-nose-mouth proportions, front-hair structure, hairline, HAIR main silhouette, HAIR key connection points and strand topology, BODY head-to-body ratio / shoulder width / limb proportions, C0 core pattern, ACC position and color relationships. No drift in age impression / gender impression / body type / head-body ratio / facial proportions / hair base."

IDENTITY_MODEL:"MAIN=IdentityCore+DepictionShell. IdentityCore is absolutely stable; DepictionShell may change dramatically. All style changes act only on the Shell and must not damage the Core."

IDENTITY_HARD_LOCK:"Strictly lock FACE, HAIR, BODY, the C0 base, and ACC layout. The same face, the same hair base, the same body proportions, the same costume base, and the same accessory logic must run through the entire video. The depiction method may change, but the subject may not."

IDENTITY_REPEAT:"Again: same MAIN,same face,same hair topology,same body proportion,same costume base,same accessories logic. Style may change, the person may not. Depiction may become wild, identity may not drift."

RENDER_NOT_REDESIGN:"CHAR_FORM is a high-intensity depiction change, not a weak filter, not a subject replacement, not a different person, and not an excuse to generate a style-icon character. The model must change MAIN's human depiction language / linework / coloring / material / 2D-3D / print / craft / abstraction level, but the change must clearly apply to MAIN as a person."

HUMAN_RENDER_RULE:"All CHAR_FORMs must directly apply to MAIN's human body itself. MAIN's face, head, hair, neck, shoulders, torso, arms, hands, waist, legs, feet, current clothing, and accessories must all be converted into the target depiction system as a whole. Must be same face in that style, same hairstyle in that style, same body proportions in that style, same costume in that style, same dance motion in that style."

NO_PROXY_SUBSTITUTION:"Proxy substitution is strictly forbidden. Do not use an unfamiliar character / independent doll / independent puppet / plush stand-in / unrelated clay figure / character poster / unfamiliar pixel character / style-typical figure to replace MAIN. Even in TOY/PLUSH/CLAY/POSTER/PIXEL/PUPPET_THEATER/WOODEN_STAGE_PUPPET forms, MAIN must remain a clearly human-shaped MAIN, not a substitute."

NO_OBJECT_ESCAPE:"Do not evade the human redraw requirement by turning MAIN into an object. Even in TOY,PLUSH,CLAY,POSTER,PIXEL,NEON,STAINED,PUPPET_THEATER,WOODEN_STAGE_PUPPET, etc., the result must still retain a clear human head/face/limbs/torso/hairstyle/clothing structure. Do not degrade into an ornament/prop/hanging picture/badge/standalone poster/non-human subject."

FORM_METAMORPHOSIS_POLICY:"Depiction changes must be obvious / large / perceptible. The goal is not slight surface differences, but to let the viewer clearly see the same MAIN being continuously rewritten through different visual media. If the identity core is already stable, prioritize amplifying style differences rather than weakening them. The goal is one subject + endlessly changing depictions."

CONSISTENCY_NOT_MONOTONY:"Consistency constrains only the IdentityCore, not the DepictionShell. Dramatic changes in linework / brushwork / material / dimensional treatment / printing method / abstraction level are allowed every 0.5s, as long as it is still instantly recognizable as the same MAIN."

FORM_FAILURE:"If a segment does not clearly show the human depiction of MAIN changing, and instead only shows an unfamiliar character / independent doll / independent puppet / background person / character poster / unrelated pixel character / style mascot, then that segment fails."

DANCE_SUPREMACY:"Aside from subject consistency, continuous dance is the second-highest priority. MAIN is always in clear dance motion from 0.00s to 15.00s. CHAR_FORM / COSTUME / BG / CAMERA / TYPO must all be executed on the moving MAIN. MAIN must not be asked to stop for the performance."

NO_STATIC:"No standing display, no mannequin-like still pose, no waiting for the camera, no stopping movement for identity anchoring, no stopping movement for costume changes, and no turning into a static display object because of PLUSH/TOY/CLAY/POSTER/PUPPET_THEATER or similar media."

ACTIVE_ANCHOR:"Identity reacquire is not a still pose. When anchoring happens, MAIN continues the current footwork / turn / arm movement, while only briefly increasing FACE/HAIR/COSTUME readability. Body motion never pauses."

goal:"15-second ultra-dense character-focused MV. MAIN continuously sings and dances in Japanese from 0s. A=change CHAR_FORM every 0.5s; B=change BG world every 1s; C=change camera grammar every 3s; D=advance costume vector every 3s; E=small single-kanji / very short English kinetic typography. Split-screen is only a background performance, not a fixed layout for the whole video."

dance:"High-energy professional club choreography at 150 BPM: heel-toe,fast footwork,side travel,hip accents,shoulder hits,chest pops,arm waves,locking,body rolls,diagonal travel,half-turns,spins,rebounds,low-high changes,brief jumps,rhythmic head turns. At least one dynamic full-body dance read + one clear FACE/lip-sync read every 1s."

es.content:
subject:"Leer IMG una sola vez y bloquear un único MAIN. Extraer de IMG FACE/HAIR/BODY/C0/ACC y el lenguaje de diseño general. Si IMG contiene múltiples vistas, tomarlas solo como referencia del mismo sujeto; si IMG es una sola imagen, prohibido generar vistas adicionales/personajes adicionales/múltiples paneles tipo character sheet. Toda la pieza tiene solo un MAIN. Fondo blanco/divisiones/etiquetas/maquetación de character sheet no pertenecen al mundo del MV."

vocal:"Voz principal original de dance music japonesa; letra no especificada; frases originales en japonés libremente improvisadas; pronunciación japonesa clara y lip sync; ganchos rítmicos fuertes, frases cortas, notas sostenidas; sin citas de canciones existentes; no leer el prompt; evitar bucles solo de ah/oh/woo."

music:"150 BPM maximal Japanese dance-pop/electro-house/hyper-club desde el primer frame; enorme kick four-on-the-floor, snare/clap apretado, sub rolling, bass sidechained, bright supersaw, percusión metálica, vocal chops, rave stabs, arps, risers, impacts. Música en primer plano, alta, densa, sin intro suave, sin breakdown silencioso. Cambio de estilo cada 0.5s = golpe acentuado; cambio de BG cada 1s = kick+impact; fase de camera/vestuario cada 3s = fill de batería + liberación de riser."

PRIORITY:"1 consistencia del sujeto 2 danza continua 3 cambios en la descripción del cuerpo principal MAIN 4 camera 5 vector de vestuario 6 BG/división 7 typo. Si hay conflicto, ceden las prioridades más bajas."

SUBJECT_SUPREMACY:"Máxima prioridad: durante toda la pieza solo existe el mismo MAIN. Todos los cambios solo pueden explicarse como el mismo MAIN re-descrito por distintos medios/ distintos lenguajes visuales populares; jamás como cambio de persona/nuevo personaje/personaje desconocido/personaje rediseñado."

SUBJECT_CORE:"Debe permanecer estable: FACE estructura ósea, forma del rostro, tipo de ojos, distancia entre ojos, proporción cejas/nariz/boca, estructura del flequillo, línea del cabello, contorno principal del HAIR, puntos clave de conexión del HAIR y topología de mechones, proporción cabeza-cuerpo/anchura de hombros/proporción de extremidades del BODY, patrón base de C0, relación de posición y color de ACC. Prohibido el drift de edad/género/complexión/proporción cabeza-cuerpo/proporción facial/matriz del peinado."

IDENTITY_MODEL:"MAIN=IdentityCore+DepictionShell. IdentityCore absolutamente estable; DepictionShell puede cambiar de forma intensa. Todos los cambios de estilo solo actúan sobre Shell, sin dañar Core."

IDENTITY_HARD_LOCK:"Bloquear estrictamente FACE, HAIR, BODY, matriz de C0 y disposición de ACC. El mismo rostro, la misma matriz de peinado, la misma proporción corporal, la misma matriz de vestuario y la misma lógica de accesorios deben atravesar toda la pieza. Puede cambiar la forma de dibujarlo, no el sujeto."

IDENTITY_REPEAT:"Reiteración: same MAIN, same face, same hair topology, same body proportion, same costume base, same accessories logic. El estilo puede cambiar, la persona no. La descripción puede volverse salvaje, la identidad no puede desviarse."

RENDER_NOT_REDESIGN:"CHAR_FORM es un cambio de descripción de alta intensidad, no un filtro suave, no una sustitución del sujeto, no un cambio de persona, no un personaje representativo del estilo generado por asociación. El modelo debe cambiar el lenguaje de dibujo del cuerpo de MAIN, las líneas, el color, el material, 2D/3D, impresión, técnica y grado de abstracción, pero el cambio debe aplicarse claramente a la propia persona MAIN."

HUMAN_RENDER_RULE:"Todos los CHAR_FORM deben aplicarse directamente al cuerpo de MAIN. El rostro, cabeza, peinado, cuello, hombros, torso, brazos, manos, cintura, piernas, pies, vestuario actual y accesorios de MAIN deben transformarse en conjunto al sistema de representación objetivo. Debe ser same face in that style, same hairstyle in that style, same body proportions in that style, same costume in that style, same dance motion in that style."

NO_PROXY_SUBSTITUTION:"Prohibida la sustitución por proxy. Prohibido usar un personaje desconocido, muñeco independiente, marioneta independiente, sustituto de peluche, figura de clay irrelevante, póster de personaje, personaje pixelado desconocido o personaje típico de estilo para reemplazar a MAIN. Incluso en formas TOY/PLUSH/CLAY/POSTER/PIXEL/PUPPET_THEATER/WOODEN_STAGE_PUPPET, debe mantenerse un MAIN humanoide claro, no un sustituto."

NO_OBJECT_ESCAPE:"Prohibido esquivar el requisito de redibujar el cuerpo convirtiendo a MAIN en un objeto. Incluso en TOY, PLUSH, CLAY, POSTER, PIXEL, NEON, STAINED, PUPPET_THEATER, WOODEN_STAGE_PUPPET, etc., deben mantenerse claramente cabeza/rostro/extremidades/torso/peinado/estructura de vestuario humanos. Prohibido degradar a adorno/prop/colgante/insignia/póster aislado/sujeto no humano."

FORM_METAMORPHOSIS_POLICY:"El cambio de descripción debe ser evidente/grande/perceptible; el objetivo no es una pequeña diferencia superficial, sino que el espectador vea claramente que el mismo MAIN está siendo reescrito de forma continua por distintos medios visuales. Si el identity core ya está estable, priorizar aumentar la diferencia de estilo en lugar de debilitarla. El objetivo es un mismo sujeto + descripción infinitamente cambiante."

CONSISTENCY_NOT_MONOTONY:"La consistencia solo restringe el IdentityCore, no el DepictionShell. Se permiten cambios drásticos cada 0.5s en línea, pincelada, material, forma de volumen, modo de impresión y grado de abstracción, siempre que siga siendo obvio a simple vista que es el mismo MAIN."

FORM_FAILURE:"Si una sección no muestra claramente que la representación corporal de MAIN está cambiando, y en su lugar solo aparece un personaje desconocido, un muñeco independiente, una marioneta independiente, un personaje de fondo, un póster de personaje, un personaje pixelado irrelevante o un objeto representativo de estilo, esa sección falla."

DANCE_SUPREMACY:"Además de la consistencia del sujeto, la danza continua es la segunda prioridad más alta. MAIN permanece en movimiento de baile claro desde 0.00s hasta 15.00s. CHAR_FORM/COSTUME/BG/CAMERA/TYPO deben ejecutarse sobre MAIN mientras se mueve. No se debe pedir a MAIN que se detenga para la puesta en escena."

NO_STATIC:"Prohibida la exhibición estática, prohibidas las poses de modelo inmóvil, prohibido esperar a la camera, prohibido detener el movimiento para anclar identidad, prohibido detenerse para cambiar de vestuario, prohibido volverse un objeto de exhibición estático por usar PLUSH/TOY/CLAY/POSTER/PUPPET_THEATER, etc."

ACTIVE_ANCHOR:"La reacquisición de identidad no es una pose estática. Cuando ocurre el anchor, MAIN continúa el paso actual/giro/movimiento de brazos, solo aumenta brevemente la legibilidad de FACE/HAIR/COSTUME. El movimiento corporal nunca se pausa."

goal:"MV de foco de personaje de altísima densidad de 15 segundos. MAIN canta y baila en japonés desde 0s de forma continua. A= cambiar CHAR_FORM cada 0.5s; B= cambiar el mundo BG cada 1s; C= cambiar la gramática de camera cada 3s; D= avanzar el vector de vestuario cada 3s; E= poca tipografía cinética de un solo kanji o inglés muy corto. La división en paneles es solo una actuación de fondo, no una maquetación fija de toda la pieza."

dance:"Coreografía profesional de club de alta energía a 150 BPM: heel-toe, fast footwork, side travel, hip accents, shoulder hits, chest pops, arm waves, locking, body rolls, diagonal travel, half-turns, spins, rebounds, cambios low-high, saltos breves, giros rítmicos de cabeza. Cada 1s debe haber al menos una lectura dinámica de baile de cuerpo completo y una lectura clara de FACE/lip-sync."

fr.content:
subject:"Ne lire IMG qu’une seule fois et verrouiller un unique MAIN. Extraire de IMG FACE/HAIR/BODY/C0/ACC ainsi que le langage de design global. Si IMG contient plusieurs vues, les utiliser uniquement comme référence d’un même sujet ; si IMG est une image unique, il est interdit de générer de soi-même des vues supplémentaires/des personnages supplémentaires/des panneaux multiples de type character sheet. Tout le film ne contient qu’un seul MAIN. Fond blanc / colonnes / annotations / mise en page de character sheet ne font pas partie de l’univers du MV."

vocal:"Lead vocal original japonais de dance music ; paroles non spécifiées ; phrases japonaises originales librement improvisées ; prononciation japonaise claire et lip sync ; hooks rythmiques forts, phrases courtes, notes tenues ; aucune citation d’une chanson existante ; ne pas lire le prompt ; éviter les boucles composées uniquement de ah/oh/woo."

music:"150 BPM maximal Japanese dance-pop/electro-house/hyper-club dès la première image ; énorme kick four-on-the-floor, snare/clap serré, sub roulant, bass sidechained, bright supersaw, percussions métalliques, vocal chops, rave stabs, arps, risers, impacts. Musique au premier plan, forte, dense, sans intro douce, sans breakdown calme. Changement de style à 0,5 s = hit accentué ; changement de BG à 1 s = kick + impact ; phase camera/costume à 3 s = fill + release de riser."

PRIORITY:"1 cohérence du sujet 2 danse continue 3 variations de description du corps de MAIN 4 camera 5 vector costume 6 BG/split screen 7 typo. En cas de conflit, les priorités inférieures cèdent."

SUBJECT_SUPREMACY:"Priorité absolue : tout le film ne contient toujours qu’un seul et même MAIN. Tous les changements ne peuvent être interprétés que comme une même MAIN redécrite par différents médias / différents langages visuels populaires, jamais comme un remplacement de personne / un nouveau personnage / un personnage inconnu / un personnage redessiné."

SUBJECT_CORE:"Doit rester stable : structure osseuse du FACE, forme du visage, forme des yeux, écart des yeux, proportions sourcils-nez-bouche, structure de la frange, ligne de naissance des cheveux, contour principal de HAIR, points de connexion clés de HAIR et topologie des mèches, proportions tête-corps / largeur d’épaules / proportions des membres de BODY, gabarit central de C0, position de ACC et relation de couleurs. Interdiction de dérive de l’âge / du genre / de la corpulence / des proportions tête-corps / des proportions du visage / du modèle de base de la coiffure."

IDENTITY_MODEL:"MAIN = IdentityCore + DepictionShell. IdentityCore est absolument stable ; DepictionShell peut changer de façon radicale. Tous les changements de style n’agissent que sur Shell et ne doivent pas détruire Core."

IDENTITY_HARD_LOCK:"Verrouillage strict de FACE, HAIR, BODY, modèle de base de C0 et disposition de ACC. Le même visage, le même modèle de base de coiffure, les mêmes proportions corporelles, le même modèle de base de costume, la même logique d’accessoires doivent traverser tout le film. La manière de dessiner peut changer, pas le sujet."

IDENTITY_REPEAT:"Encore une fois : same MAIN, same face, same hair topology, same body proportion, same costume base, same accessories logic. Le style peut changer, la personne ne peut pas changer. La description peut devenir furieuse, l’identité ne doit pas dériver."

RENDER_NOT_REDESIGN:"CHAR_FORM est une variation de description à haute intensité, pas un filtre léger, pas un remplacement du sujet, pas un changement de personne, pas un prétexte pour générer un personnage emblématique du style. Le modèle doit changer le langage de dessin du corps de MAIN / les lignes / la colorisation / la matière / le 2D-3D / l’impression / le procédé / le degré d’abstraction, mais ce changement doit s’appliquer clairement à MAIN lui-même."

HUMAN_RENDER_RULE:"Tous les CHAR_FORM doivent s’appliquer directement au corps même de MAIN. Le visage, la tête, la coiffure, le cou, les épaules, le torse, les bras, les mains, la taille, les jambes, les pieds, le costume actuel et les accessoires de MAIN doivent être entièrement transposés dans le système de représentation cible. Il faut same face in that style, same hairstyle in that style, same body proportions in that style, same costume in that style, same dance motion in that style."

NO_PROXY_SUBSTITUTION:"Substitution par proxy strictement interdite. Il est interdit d’utiliser un personnage inconnu / une poupée indépendante / une marionnette indépendante / un substitut en peluche / une figurine en argile sans rapport / une affiche de personnage / un personnage pixel inconnu / un personnage typique du style pour remplacer MAIN. Même sous forme TOY / PLUSH / CLAY / POSTER / PIXEL / PUPPET_THEATER / WOODEN_STAGE_PUPPET, il faut conserver un MAIN humanoïde clairement identifiable, pas un substitut."

NO_OBJECT_ESCAPE:"Il est interdit de contourner l’exigence de redessin du corps en transformant MAIN en objet. Même en TOY, PLUSH, CLAY, POSTER, PIXEL, NEON, STAINED, PUPPET_THEATER, WOODEN_STAGE_PUPPET, il faut conserver une tête humaine / un visage / des membres / un torse / une coiffure / une structure vestimentaire clairement humains. Interdiction de régresser vers un bibelot / un accessoire / une image suspendue / un badge / une affiche isolée / un sujet non humain."

FORM_METAMORPHOSIS_POLICY:"Les changements de description doivent être évidents / amples / perceptibles ; l’objectif n’est pas une légère différence de surface, mais de faire voir clairement au spectateur qu’une même MAIN est continuellement réécrite par différents médias visuels. Si le identity core est déjà stable, il faut renforcer les différences de style plutôt que les affaiblir. L’objectif est un même sujet + des descriptions infiniment variées."

CONSISTENCY_NOT_MONOTONY:"La cohérence ne contraint que l’IdentityCore, pas le DepictionShell. Des changements brutaux de lignes / coups de pinceau / matière / mode de volume / mode d’impression / degré d’abstraction entre 0,5 s sont autorisés, tant qu’on peut encore reconnaître d’un coup d’œil qu’il s’agit du même MAIN."

FORM_FAILURE:"Si une séquence ne montre pas clairement que la représentation du corps de MAIN change, mais qu’elle fait seulement apparaître un personnage inconnu / une poupée indépendante / une marionnette indépendante / un personnage de fond / une affiche de personnage / un personnage pixel sans rapport / un objet emblématique du style, alors cette séquence échoue."

DANCE_SUPREMACY:"En dehors de la cohérence du sujet, la danse continue est la deuxième priorité absolue. MAIN reste en mouvement de danse explicite de 0,00 s à 15,00 s. CHAR_FORM / COSTUME / BG / CAMERA / TYPO doivent tous s’appliquer à MAIN pendant qu’il bouge. Il est interdit de demander à MAIN de s’arrêter pour la mise en scène."

NO_STATIC:"Interdiction de pose d’exposition debout, interdiction de pose figée de mannequin, interdiction d’attendre la camera, interdiction d’arrêter le mouvement pour l’ancrage d’identité, interdiction d’arrêter le mouvement pour le changement de tenue, interdiction de devenir un objet d’exposition immobile à cause de PLUSH / TOY / CLAY / POSTER / PUPPET_THEATER ou autres médias."

ACTIVE_ANCHOR:"Le reacquire d’identité n’est pas une pose figée. Lors de l’ancrage, MAIN continue son pas / sa rotation / son mouvement de bras en cours, en augmentant seulement brièvement la lisibilité du FACE / HAIR / COSTUME. Le mouvement du corps ne s’interrompt jamais."

goal:"MV centré sur le personnage, ultra-dense, 15 secondes. MAIN chante et danse en japonais en continu dès 0 s. A = changement de CHAR_FORM toutes les 0,5 s ; B = changement de monde BG toutes les 1 s ; C = changement de grammaire camera toutes les 3 s ; D = progression du vector costume toutes les 3 s ; E = petite quantité de typographie cinétique en un seul kanji / très courts mots anglais. Le split screen n’est qu’une mise en scène de fond, pas une disposition fixe de tout le film."

dance:"Chorégraphie club professionnelle à haute énergie à 150 BPM : heel-toe, fast footwork, side travel, hip accents, shoulder hits, chest pops, arm waves, locking, body rolls, déplacements diagonaux, demi-tours, spins, rebounds, changements bas-haut, petits sauts, rotations rythmiques de la tête. Au moins une lecture dynamique du corps entier + une lecture claire du FACE / lip-sync chaque seconde."

ko.content:
subject:"IMG를 한 번만 읽고 유일한 MAIN을 고정한다. IMG에서 FACE/HAIR/BODY/C0/ACC와 전체 디자인 언어를 추출한다. IMG가 멀티뷰를 포함하면 같은 주체에 대한 참고로만 사용하고, IMG가 단일 이미지라면 추가 뷰/추가 인물/캐릭터 시트식 멀티 패널을 임의 생성하지 않는다. 전체 영상에는 오직 하나의 MAIN만 존재한다. 흰 배경/분할/주석/캐릭터 시트식 레이아웃은 MV 세계관에 속하지 않는다."

vocal:"Original Japanese dance-music lead vocal; lyrics unspecified; freely improvised original Japanese phrases; clear Japanese pronunciation and lip sync; strong rhythmic hooks, short phrases, sustained notes; no existing-song quotation; no prompt reading; avoid ah/oh/woo-only loops."

music:"150 BPM maximal Japanese dance-pop/electro-house/hyper-club from frame one; huge four-on-floor kick,tight snare/clap,rolling sub,sidechained bass,bright supersaw,metallic percussion,vocal chops,rave stabs,arps,risers,impacts. Music foreground,loud,dense,no soft intro,no quiet breakdown. 0.5s style shift=accented hit;1s BG shift=kick+impact;3s camera/costume phase=fill+riser release."

PRIORITY:"1주체 일치 2연속 댄스 3MAIN 본체 묘사 변화 4camera 5의상 vector 6BG/분할 7typo. 충돌 시 낮은 우선순위가 양보한다."

SUBJECT_SUPREMACY:"최우선: 전체 영상 내내 오직 같은 MAIN만 존재한다. 모든 변화는 같은 MAIN이 서로 다른 매체/서로 다른 대중적 비주얼 언어로 다시 묘사되는 것으로만 해석되어야 하며, 절대로 교체된 인물/새 캐릭터/낯선 캐릭터/재디자인된 캐릭터로 해석되어서는 안 된다."

SUBJECT_CORE:"반드시 안정적으로 유지: FACE 골격, 얼굴형, 눈 형태, 눈 사이 거리, 눈썹/코/입 비율, 앞머리 구조, 헤어라인, HAIR의 주된 윤곽, HAIR의 핵심 연결점과 가닥 topology, BODY의 머리-몸 비율/어깨 너비/사지 비율, C0의 핵심 패턴, ACC의 위치와 배색 관계. 나이감/성별감/체형/머리-몸 비율/얼굴 비율/헤어 원형의 드리프트는 금지."

IDENTITY_MODEL:"MAIN=IdentityCore+DepictionShell. IdentityCore는 절대적으로 안정적이며, DepictionShell은 강하게 변할 수 있다. 모든 스타일 변화는 Shell에만 작용해야 하며 Core를 훼손해서는 안 된다."

IDENTITY_HARD_LOCK:"FACE, HAIR, BODY, C0 원형과 ACC 배치를 엄격히 고정한다. 같은 얼굴, 같은 헤어 원형, 같은 신체 비율, 같은 의상 원형, 같은 액세서리 논리가 전체 영상에 걸쳐 관통해야 한다. 묘사 방식은 바꿀 수 있지만 주체는 바뀌면 안 된다."

IDENTITY_REPEAT:"다시 강조: same MAIN,same face,same hair topology,same body proportion,same costume base,same accessories logic. 스타일은 변해도 사람은 변하면 안 된다. 묘사는 격렬해도 정체성은 흔들리면 안 된다."

RENDER_NOT_REDESIGN:"CHAR_FORM은 강도 높은 묘사 변화이지, 약한 필터도 아니고, 주체 교체도 아니고, 인물 교체도 아니며, 주제를 빌미로 스타일 대표 캐릭터를 생성하는 것도 아니다. 모델은 MAIN의 인체 묘사 언어/선/채색/재질/2D·3D/인쇄/공정/추상 정도를 바꿔야 하지만, 그 변화는 반드시 MAIN이라는 그 사람 자체에 명확히 작용해야 한다."

HUMAN_RENDER_RULE:"모든 CHAR_FORM은 MAIN의 인체 본체에 직접 작용해야 한다. MAIN의 얼굴, 머리, 헤어스타일, 목, 어깨, 몸통, 팔, 손, 허리, 다리, 발, 현재 의상, 액세서리는 모두 목표 묘사 체계로 통째로 변환되어야 한다. 반드시 same face in that style,same hairstyle in that style,same body proportions in that style,same costume in that style,same dance motion in that style."

NO_PROXY_SUBSTITUTION:"대리 대체를 엄격히 금지한다. 낯선 캐릭터/독립 인형/독립 꼭두각시/플러시 대역/무관한 클레이 피규어/인물 포스터/낯선 픽셀 캐릭터/스타일 전형 인물로 MAIN을 대체해서는 안 된다. TOY/PLUSH/CLAY/POSTER/PIXEL/PUPPET_THEATER/WOODEN_STAGE_PUPPET 등의 형식이라도, 분명한 인간형 MAIN이어야 하며 대체물이 되어서는 안 된다."

NO_OBJECT_ESCAPE:"MAIN을 물건으로 바꿔 인체 재묘사 요구를 회피하는 것은 금지된다. TOY,PLUSH,CLAY,POSTER,PIXEL,NEON,STAINED,PUPPET_THEATER,WOODEN_STAGE_PUPPET 등이라도, 분명한 인간의 머리/얼굴/사지/몸통/헤어스타일/의상 구조를 유지해야 한다. 장식품/소품/걸개 그림/배지/단독 포스터/비인간 주체로 퇴화해서는 안 된다."

FORM_METAMORPHOSIS_POLICY:"묘사 변화는 분명하고/크고/인지 가능해야 하며, 목표는 미세한 표면 차이가 아니라 관객이 같은 MAIN이 서로 다른 시각 매체로 연속적으로 다시 쓰이고 있음을 명확히 보게 하는 것이다. identity core가 이미 안정적이라면, 그것을 약화시키기보다 스타일 차이를 강화해야 한다. 목표는 같은 주체 + 천차만별의 묘사다."

CONSISTENCY_NOT_MONOTONY:"일관성은 IdentityCore에만 적용되며 DepictionShell에는 적용되지 않는다. 0.5초 사이에 선, 붓질, 재질, 입체 방식, 인쇄 방식, 추상 정도가 급변해도, 여전히 한눈에 같은 MAIN임을 판단할 수 있으면 된다."

FORM_FAILURE:"어떤 구간이 MAIN이라는 사람의 인체 묘사 변화로 분명하게 보이지 않고, 낯선 캐릭터/독립 인형/독립 꼭두각시/배경 인물/인물 포스터/무관한 픽셀 캐릭터/스타일 대표물만 나타난다면 그 구간은 실패다."

DANCE_SUPREMACY:"주체 일치성 외에 연속 댄스는 두 번째로 높은 우선순위다. MAIN은 0.00s부터 15.00s까지 계속 명확한 댄스 동작 중이어야 한다. CHAR_FORM/COSTUME/BG/CAMERA/TYPO는 모두 움직이고 있는 MAIN에 부착되어 실행되어야 한다. MAIN이 멈춰서 연출에 맞추도록 해서는 안 된다."

NO_STATIC:"서 있는 전시 금지, 모델처럼 정지 포즈 금지, camera를 기다리는 행위 금지, identity anchor를 위해 동작을 멈추는 것 금지, 의상 변경을 위해 멈추는 것 금지, PLUSH/TOY/CLAY/POSTER/PUPPET_THEATER 등의 매체 때문에 정지 전시물로 변하는 것 금지."

ACTIVE_ANCHOR:"identity reacquire는 정지 포즈가 아니다. anchor가 발생할 때 MAIN은 현재의 스텝/턴/arm movement를 계속하며, FACE/HAIR/COSTUME의 가독성만 잠시 높인다. 신체 움직임은 절대 멈추지 않는다."

goal:"15초 초고밀도 캐릭터 중심 MV. MAIN은 0s부터 지속적으로 일본어로 노래하고 춤춘다. A=0.5s마다 CHAR_FORM 전환;B=1s마다 BG 세계 전환;C=3s마다 camera grammar 전환;D=3s마다 의상 vector 진행;E=소량의 단일 한자/아주 짧은 영문 kinetic typography. 분할 화면은 배경 연출일 뿐, 전체 영상의 고정 레이아웃이 아니다."

dance:"High-energy professional club choreography at 150 BPM: heel-toe,fast footwork,side travel,hip accents,shoulder hits,chest pops,arm waves,locking,body rolls,diagonal travel,half-turns,spins,rebounds,low-high changes,brief jumps,rhythmic head turns. 매

pt.content:
subject:"Ler IMG apenas uma vez e fixar um único MAIN. Extrair de IMG FACE/HAIR/BODY/C0/ACC e a linguagem de design geral. Se IMG contiver múltiplas vistas, usá-las apenas como referência do mesmo sujeito; se IMG for uma única imagem, é proibido gerar por conta própria vistas extras/pessoas extras/painéis múltiplos no estilo character sheet. O filme inteiro tem apenas um MAIN. Fundo branco/divisões/legendas/diagramação de character sheet não pertencem ao mundo do MV."

vocal:"Vocal principal original de dance music japonesa; letra não especificada; frases originais em japonês livremente improvisadas; pronúncia japonesa clara e lip sync; ganchos rítmicos fortes, frases curtas, notas sustentadas; sem citação de músicas existentes; sem leitura de prompt; evitar loops apenas com ah/oh/woo."

music:"150 BPM maximal Japanese dance-pop/electro-house/hyper-club desde o primeiro frame; kick four-on-the-floor enorme, snare/clap apertado, sub rolante, bass sidechained, supersaw brilhante, percussão metálica, vocal chops, rave stabs, arps, risers, impacts. Música em primeiro plano, alta, densa, sem intro suave, sem breakdown silencioso. Mudança de estilo a cada 0,5s = hit acentuado; mudança de BG a cada 1s = kick + impact; fase de camera/figurino a cada 3s = fill de bateria + release de riser."

PRIORITY:"1 consistência do sujeito 2 dança contínua 3 mudanças na descrição do próprio MAIN 4 camera 5 vector de figurino 6 BG/divisão 7 typo. Se houver conflito, a prioridade mais baixa cede."

SUBJECT_SUPREMACY:"Prioridade máxima: o filme inteiro deve ter sempre o mesmo MAIN. Todas as mudanças só podem ser interpretadas como o mesmo MAIN sendo reescrito por diferentes mídias/diferentes linguagens visuais populares, jamais como troca de pessoa/novo personagem/personagem desconhecido/personagem redesenhado."

SUBJECT_CORE:"Deve permanecer estável: ossatura facial do FACE, formato do rosto, formato dos olhos, distância entre os olhos, proporção entre sobrancelhas/nariz/boca, estrutura da franja, linha do cabelo, contorno principal do HAIR, pontos-chave de conexão do HAIR e topologia dos fios, proporção cabeça-corpo do BODY/largura dos ombros/proporção dos membros, molde-base do C0, posição do ACC e relação de cores. Proibido drift de idade/gênero/tipo físico/proporção cabeça-corpo/proporção facial/matriz do penteado."

IDENTITY_MODEL:"MAIN=IdentityCore+DepictionShell. IdentityCore absolutamente estável; DepictionShell pode mudar intensamente. Todas as mudanças de estilo atuam apenas no Shell, sem quebrar o Core."

IDENTITY_HARD_LOCK:"Bloqueio rígido de FACE, HAIR, BODY, matriz do C0 e layout do ACC. O mesmo rosto, a mesma matriz de cabelo, a mesma proporção corporal, a mesma matriz de roupa, a mesma lógica de acessórios devem atravessar o filme inteiro. A forma de desenhar pode mudar, o sujeito não pode mudar."

IDENTITY_REPEAT:"Reforçando: same MAIN, same face, same hair topology, same body proportion, same costume base, same accessories logic. O estilo pode variar, a pessoa não pode mudar. A descrição pode ser brutal, a identidade não pode derivar."

RENDER_NOT_REDESIGN:"CHAR_FORM é uma mudança de descrição de alta intensidade, não um filtro fraco, não substituição do sujeito, não troca de pessoa, não criação oportunista de um personagem representativo do estilo. O modelo deve mudar a linguagem de desenho do corpo do MAIN/linhas/colorização/materialidade/2D-3D/impressão/processo/grau de abstração, mas a mudança deve atuar claramente sobre o MAIN como pessoa."

HUMAN_RENDER_RULE:"Todos os CHAR_FORM devem atuar diretamente sobre o corpo do MAIN. O rosto, cabeça, cabelo, pescoço, ombros, tronco, braços, mãos, cintura, pernas, pés, roupa atual e acessórios do MAIN devem ser convertidos como um todo para o sistema de representação-alvo. Deve ser same face in that style, same hairstyle in that style, same body proportions in that style, same costume in that style, same dance motion in that style."

NO_PROXY_SUBSTITUTION:"Substituição por proxy é estritamente proibida. É proibido usar personagem desconhecido/boneco independente/marionete independente/substituto de pelúcia/figura de clay irrelevante/cartaz de pessoa/personagem pixelado desconhecido/personagem típico de estilo para substituir o MAIN. Mesmo em formas TOY/PLUSH/CLAY/POSTER/PIXEL/PUPPET_THEATER/WOODEN_STAGE_PUPPET etc., o MAIN deve permanecer claramente humanoide, não um substituto."

NO_OBJECT_ESCAPE:"É proibido escapar da exigência de redesenho corporal transformando o MAIN em um objeto. Mesmo em TOY, PLUSH, CLAY, POSTER, PIXEL, NEON, STAINED, PUPPET_THEATER, WOODEN_STAGE_PUPPET etc., devem permanecer claramente cabeça/rosto/membros/tronco/cabelo/estrutura de roupa humanos. Proibido degradar para enfeite/prop/quadros pendurados/broche/cartaz isolado/sujeito não humano."

FORM_METAMORPHOSIS_POLICY:"A mudança de descrição deve ser óbvia/grande/perceptível; o objetivo não é uma diferença superficial pequena, mas fazer o público ver claramente o mesmo MAIN sendo reescrito continuamente por diferentes mídias visuais. Se o identity core já estiver estável, priorize aumentar a diferença de estilo em vez de enfraquecê-la. O objetivo é um único sujeito + descrição infinitamente mutável."

CONSISTENCY_NOT_MONOTONY:"Consistência só restringe o IdentityCore, não o DepictionShell. É permitido que entre 0,5s e 0,5s haja mudanças drásticas de linha/pincelada/materialidade/forma 2D-3D/processo de impressão/grau de abstração, desde que ainda seja possível reconhecer de imediato que é o mesmo MAIN."

FORM_FAILURE:"Se algum trecho não mostrar claramente que a representação corporal do MAIN está mudando, e em vez disso aparecer apenas um personagem desconhecido/boneco independente/marionete independente/personagem de fundo/cartaz de pessoa/personagem pixelado irrelevante/objeto representativo de estilo, então esse trecho falha."

DANCE_SUPREMACY:"Além da consistência do sujeito, a dança contínua é a segunda prioridade mais alta. O MAIN deve estar em movimento de dança claro de 0,00s a 15,00s. CHAR_FORM/COSTUME/BG/CAMERA/TYPO devem todos ser aplicados ao MAIN em movimento. Não se deve pedir que o MAIN pare para a performance."

NO_STATIC:"Proibido pose estática de apresentação, proibido pose parada de modelo, proibido esperar a camera, proibido parar o movimento para anchor de identidade, proibido parar para troca de roupa, proibido virar objeto de exibição estático por causa de PLUSH/TOY/CLAY/POSTER/PUPPET_THEATER etc."

ACTIVE_ANCHOR:"identity reacquire não é pose estática. Quando o anchor acontece, o MAIN continua o passo atual/giro/movimento de braço, apenas aumenta temporariamente a legibilidade de FACE/HAIR/COSTUME. O movimento corporal nunca pausa."

goal:"MV de foco de personagem com densidade ultraalta de 15 segundos. O MAIN canta e dança em japonês continuamente desde 0s. A=troca de CHAR_FORM a cada 0,5s; B=troca do mundo BG a cada 1s; C=troca da gramática de camera a cada 3s; D=avanço do vector de figurino a cada 3s; E=pequenos kanji únicos/inglês curtíssimo em kinetic typography. Split screen é apenas performance de fundo, não layout fixo do filme inteiro."

dance:"Coreografia profissional de club de alta energia a 150 BPM: heel-toe, footwork rápido, deslocamento lateral, acentos de quadril, shoulder hits, chest pops, arm waves, locking, body rolls, deslocamento diagonal, meio-giro, spins, rebounds, mudanças de nível baixo/alto, pequenos saltos, viradas rítmicas de cabeça. A cada 1s, pelo menos uma leitura dinâmica de corpo inteiro e uma leitura clara de FACE/lip-sync."

zh.content:
subject:"仅读取IMG一次并锁定唯一MAIN。从IMG提取FACE/HAIR/BODY/C0/ACC与整体设计语言。若IMG含多视图，仅作同一主体参考；若IMG为单图，禁止自行生成额外视图/额外人物/角色表式多面板。全片只有一个MAIN。白底/分栏/标注/角色表排版不属于MV世界。"

vocal:"Original Japanese dance-music lead vocal; lyrics unspecified; freely improvised original Japanese phrases; clear Japanese pronunciation and lip sync; strong rhythmic hooks, short phrases, sustained notes; no existing-song quotation; no prompt reading; avoid ah/oh/woo-only loops."

music:"150 BPM maximal Japanese dance-pop/electro-house/hyper-club from frame one; huge four-on-floor kick,tight snare/clap,rolling sub,sidechained bass,bright supersaw,metallic percussion,vocal chops,rave stabs,arps,risers,impacts. Music foreground,loud,dense,no soft intro,no quiet breakdown. 0.5s style shift=accented hit;1s BG shift=kick+impact;3s camera/costume phase=fill+riser release."

PRIORITY:"1主体一致 2连续舞蹈 3MAIN本体描写变化 4camera 5服装vector 6BG/分屏 7typo. 若冲突,低优先级让步."

SUBJECT_SUPREMACY:"最高优先级: 全片始终只有同一个MAIN。所有变化只能解释为同一MAIN被不同媒介/不同流行视觉语言重新描写，绝不能解释为换人/新角色/陌生角色/重新设计角色。"

SUBJECT_CORE:"必须稳定: FACE骨相,脸型,眼型,眼距,眉鼻口比例,前发结构,发际线,HAIR主轮廓,HAIR关键连接点与发束拓扑,BODY头身比/肩宽/四肢比例,C0核心版型,ACC位置与配色关系. 禁止年龄感/性别感/体型/头身比/脸部比例/发型母体漂移."

IDENTITY_MODEL:"MAIN=IdentityCore+DepictionShell. IdentityCore绝对稳定;DepictionShell可激烈变化. 所有风格变化只作用于Shell,不得破坏Core."

IDENTITY_HARD_LOCK:"严格锁定FACE,HAIR,BODY,C0母体与ACC布局。同一张脸,同一发型母体,同一身体比例,同一服装母体,同一饰品逻辑必须贯穿全片。可以变描画方式,不能变主体。"

IDENTITY_REPEAT:"再次强调: same MAIN,same face,same hair topology,same body proportion,same costume base,same accessories logic. 风格可变,人不能变。描写可狂暴,身份不能漂。"

RENDER_NOT_REDESIGN:"CHAR_FORM是高强度描写变化,不是弱滤镜,不是主体替换,不是换人,不是借题发挥生成风格代表角色。模型必须改变MAIN的人体描画语言/线条/上色/材质/二维三维/印刷/工艺/抽象程度,但变化必须明确作用于MAIN这个人本身。"

HUMAN_RENDER_RULE:"所有CHAR_FORM都必须直接作用于MAIN的人体本体。MAIN的人脸,头部,发型,颈部,肩膀,躯干,手臂,手,腰部,腿部,脚部,当前服装,饰品必须整体转换到目标描写体系。必须same face in that style,same hairstyle in that style,same body proportions in that style,same costume in that style,same dance motion in that style."

NO_PROXY_SUBSTITUTION:"严禁代理替换。禁止用陌生角色/独立玩偶/独立木偶/毛绒代角/无关黏土人/人物海报/陌生像素角色/风格典型人物来代替MAIN。即使TOY/PLUSH/CLAY/POSTER/PIXEL/PUPPET_THEATER/WOODEN_STAGE_PUPPET等形式,也必须保持清楚的人形MAIN,不是替代物。"

NO_OBJECT_ESCAPE:"禁止通过把MAIN变成一个物件来规避人体重绘要求。即使是TOY,PLUSH,CLAY,POSTER,PIXEL,NEON,STAINED,PUPPET_THEATER,WOODEN_STAGE_PUPPET等,也必须保持清楚的人类头部/脸部/四肢/躯干/发型/服装结构。禁止退化成摆件/道具/挂画/徽章/单独海报/非人主体。"

FORM_METAMORPHOSIS_POLICY:"描写变化必须明显/大幅/可感知,目标不是轻微表面差异,而是让观众明确看到同一MAIN正在被不同视觉媒介连续改写。若identity core已稳定,优先增强风格差异而不是弱化它。目标是同一主体+千变万化描写。"

CONSISTENCY_NOT_MONOTONY:"一致性只约束IdentityCore,不约束DepictionShell。允许0.5s之间线条/笔触/材质/立体方式/印刷方式/抽象程度剧变,只要仍然一眼可判断是同一MAIN。"

FORM_FAILURE:"若某段没有清楚表现为MAIN这个人的人体描写发生变化,而只是出现陌生角色/独立玩偶/独立木偶/背景人物/人物海报/无关像素角色/风格代表物,则该段失败。"

DANCE_SUPREMACY:"除主体一致性外,连续舞蹈是第二最高优先级。MAIN从0.00s到15.00s始终处于明确舞蹈动作中。CHAR_FORM/COSTUME/BG/CAMERA/TYPO都必须附着在正在运动的MAIN上执行。不得要求MAIN停下配合演出。"

NO_STATIC:"禁止站立展示,禁止模特式静止pose,禁止等待camera,禁止为了identity anchor停止动作,禁止为了换装停止动作,禁止因为PLUSH/TOY/CLAY/POSTER/PUPPET_THEATER等媒介而变成静止展示物。"

ACTIVE_ANCHOR:"identity reacquire不是静止pose。anchor发生时MAIN继续当前脚步/转身/arm movement,只短暂提升FACE/HAIR/COSTUME可读性。身体运动绝不暂停。"

goal:"15秒超高密度角色焦点MV。MAIN从0s持续日语唱跳。A=每0.5s切换CHAR_FORM;B=每1s切换BG世界;C=每3s切换camera grammar;D=每3s推进服装vector;E=少量单汉字/极短英字kinetic typography。分屏只是背景演出,不是全片固定布局。"

dance:"High-energy professional club choreography at 150 BPM: heel-toe,fast footwork,side travel,hip accents,shoulder hits,chest pops,arm waves,locking,body rolls,diagonal travel,half-turns,spins,rebounds,low-high changes,brief jumps,rhythmic head turns. 每1s至少一次动态全身dance read+一次清晰FACE/lip-sync read."
